description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
Sidebar top layout optimized with native macOS window controls enabled.
Custom and connected models are grouped by provider in the model menu.
Profile cards show subscription, purchase, and upgrade entries based on plan status.
A new Launch at Login toggle is available in General settings.
Desktop skills and plugins now support isolated environment invocation.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
